evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/y/a is a RUNTIME-retained METHOD-target annotation with exactly three elements: long interval, ChronoUnit unit, and a boolean flag defaulting to false.
The live rs/s/g subsystem scans public methods with Method.getAnnotation(rs/y/a.class), creates a ScheduledMethod record for each annotated method and registers it with the scheduler.
The scheduler combines the annotation interval and ChronoUnit into a Duration and uses the boolean flag to choose executor submission versus direct invocation when the task becomes due.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 annotation name for methods declared as periodic scheduled tasks. Element/member names are not proposed in this class-only batch.

evidence.detail: The class's own toString format is literally 'ScheduledMethod(schedule=..., method=..., object=..., lambda=..., last=...)', directly preserving its semantic noun.
It stores the rs/y/a schedule annotation, reflected Method, owning object, optional Runnable lambda and last-trigger Instant; construction initializes last-trigger to Instant.now().
The live scanner creates one rs/y/b per annotated method, logs 'Scheduled task {}', registers it with rs/y/c, and removes records owned by a plugin/service when that object is unloaded.

candidates.note: ScheduledMethod is directly corroborated by the exact-v308 preserved toString text.

evidence.detail: The class is a singleton service with an injected ScheduledExecutorService and a CopyOnWriteArrayList<ScheduledMethod>; it exposes add/remove/unmodifiable-list operations.

Each tick compares Duration.between(last, now) against Duration.of(annotation interval, annotation ChronoUnit), logs 'Scheduled task triggered: {}', updates last-trigger and executes only due records.

When the annotation boolean is true the scheduler submits the record through ScheduledExecutorService; otherwise it invokes the Runnable/reflected method inline, with dedicated warning paths for invocation/task errors.
R321 ClientApplicationModule binds rs/y/c into the root Guice application graph, while live plugin/service scanning owns its ScheduledMethod registration lifecycle.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 scheduler name for the service that executes registered ScheduledMethod records when their annotation-defined interval elapses.
